import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import os
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer
from sklearn.svm import LinearSVC
from sklearn.calibration import CalibratedClassifierCV
from sklearn.metrics import log_loss
from scipy.sparse import hstack

# Load data
train_df = pd.read_csv("./input/train.csv")
test_df = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")

# Prepare data
X = train_df["text"]
y = train_df["author"]
X_test = test_df["text"]
ids_test = test_df["id"]

# Split train into train and validation sets
X_train, X_val, y_train, y_val = train_test_split(
    X, y, test_size=0.2, stratify=y, random_state=42
)

# Initialize TF-IDF vectorizers
word_vectorizer = TfidfVectorizer(
    ngram_range=(1, 2), max_features=50000, sublinear_tf=True
)
char_vectorizer = TfidfVectorizer(
    ngram_range=(3, 5), analyzer="char", max_features=50000, sublinear_tf=True
)

# Transform training data
X_train_word = word_vectorizer.fit_transform(X_train)
X_train_char = char_vectorizer.fit_transform(X_train)
X_train_combined = hstack([X_train_word, X_train_char])

# Transform validation data
X_val_word = word_vectorizer.transform(X_val)
X_val_char = char_vectorizer.transform(X_val)
X_val_combined = hstack([X_val_word, X_val_char])

# Initialize and train model
base_clf = LinearSVC(random_state=42, max_iter=5000)
clf = CalibratedClassifierCV(base_clf, method="sigmoid", cv=3)
clf.fit(X_train_combined, y_train)

# Predict on validation set
y_val_pred = clf.predict_proba(X_val_combined)
val_score = log_loss(y_val, y_val_pred)
print(f"Validation Log Loss: {val_score}")

# Retrain on full training data for submission
X_train_full_word = word_vectorizer.fit_transform(train_df["text"])
X_train_full_char = char_vectorizer.fit_transform(train_df["text"])
X_train_full_combined = hstack([X_train_full_word, X_train_full_char])

clf_full = CalibratedClassifierCV(
    LinearSVC(random_state=42, max_iter=5000), method="sigmoid", cv=3
)
clf_full.fit(X_train_full_combined, train_df["author"])

# Predict on test data
X_test_word = word_vectorizer.transform(X_test)
X_test_char = char_vectorizer.transform(X_test)
X_test_combined = hstack([X_test_word, X_test_char])

y_test_pred = clf_full.predict_proba(X_test_combined)

# Prepare submission
submission = pd.DataFrame({"id": ids_test})
for i, cls in enumerate(clf_full.classes_):
    submission[cls] = y_test_pred[:, i]

# Save submission
os.makedirs("submission", exist_ok=True)
submission.to_csv("submission/submission.csv", index=False)
